Ketamine found to have an "unbelievable" effect in treating severe depression | We Are Change

I am not surprised by this at all. I found ketamine, and later, methoxetamine, to have considerable benefits for mood and general motivation, long after the primary effects wore off (and even the secondary effects like the difficulty finding words, or sexual dysfunction, which can last a couple times longer than the primary effects, were long gone).

Dextromethorphan, as found in over-the-counter cough syrup, also has some effect but is significantly inferior to either K or MXE. It's "dirty" (comes with more side effects) and is considerably less pleasant to take. All of its obvious effects, both primary and secondary, last much longer than with K or MXE, but I did not find the mood effects to last proportionally longer. They were longer, yes, but not in direct proportion to the duration of the more obvious effects.

I think the researchers should take a look at methoxetamine, as it may prove to have increased duration. It's also quite easy to administer -- I used to dump it in warm coffee and drink it and not even notice it was there. (This works for ketamine too, it's one of the least offensive-tasting drugs I can think of.) Injection or snorting are absolutely not necessary.

These are my experiences only and I don't intend to portray them as typical. Ketamine: Trip pleasantly for 45 minutes, be hung over for a couple hours, feel generally better for a day or two. Methoxetamine: Trip pleasantly for an hour and a half, be hung over most of the evening, wake up the next day feeling great and this lasts three or four days. DXM: Trip with mixed effects (much foggier mentally than the other two, plus feeling sick to my stomach), taking a couple hours to come up versus minutes for the above. It's eight hours to the end of the trip, neglecting closed-eye visuals which may continue well into the next day (which are not present with K or MXE at all). Be hung over well into the next day. Mood effects last 5 to 7 days.

If the mood effects are the primary purpose, then K and MXE probably hold equal promise. It's just that the K doses have to be closer together. If one likes to trip as well as receive the mood effects, then I suppose it's largely a matter of taste and lifestyle. One could quite conceivably K-trip daily and still conduct a more or less normal life (not that I recommend trying), MXE would probably hamper one's social life but not prevent going to work every day, and DXM will just fuck your shit up as far as schedule goes.
